## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link any relevant issue.

## Mathematical conventions

For mathematical changes, state the basis, coproduct, grading and source
reference. Explain whether published examples or stored outputs change.
Omit this section for changes that do not affect calculations.

## Validation

State which checks you ran and their results. For code changes, run
`make check`; for paper examples, also run `make listings`.
